title: Alienware 27" 240Hz QD-OLED Gaming Monitor AW2726DM $466.96 Delivered @ Dell
body:
Deal: Alienware 27" 240Hz QD-OLED Gaming Monitor AW2726DM $466.96 Delivered @ Dell

[FireRunner] QHD is not crazy difficult to run unlike 4K but yeah, just having less budget available means monitors need to be priced low just to move models.
[Emphasise] Perfectly balanced, as all things should be
[FireRunner] Didn't neg but gaming laptops are expensive now too.
You'd still get better value with a desktop
[puffinpop] I keep an eye out for marketplace deals. I'm still stuck on the AM4 socket, I recently brought a Ryzen 5500X3D for $250 (marketplace). Eventually I will have to make the jump to AM5.
[gunslinger] I switched from desktop to laptop but you'll have to pry my dual 27" monitors out of my cold dead hands.
One of the best quality of life upgrades you can get if you spend a lot of time in front of a screen.
[Count Shagula] I've gone through several variations of monitor setups and personally think 2 x 27"s are the best also. I have the left in landscape and the right in portrait mode
[Carpo] Code also works for the slightly better model - AW2725D $599 comes down to $532.55 with the code
https://www.dell.com/en-au/shop/cty/apd/210-BSCQ
280Hz - QD-OLED
2 HDMI ports (HDCP 1.4 & 2.3) (Supports up to QHD 2560 x 1440, 280 Hz, 10 bit, FRL, HDR, VRR as per specified in HDMI 2.1)
1 DisplayPort 1.4 (HDCP 1.4 & 2.3) port (Supports up to QHD 2560 x 1440, 280 Hz, HDR, DSC, VRR)
[ozchobie] Sad that only Kick provides Dell cashback now with a measly 1.5 percent max.
[worthy1] Is that good? After a decent gaming monitor for my nephews. Not wanting to spring for OLED for them but want a decent IPS.
[troopyjw] i cant workout why the 34" is significantly cheaper than the 32"
[Sleepycat3] It is an ultrawide. The height is equivalent to a 16:9 aspect ratio 27", so it is easier to produce as a single panel compared to the 32".
[potatoaim] Does anyone own one of these or something similar?
Just curious about how it performs in the UFO test on these monitors.
The result on my old 144Hz IPS is terrible.
[notaccel] The Monitors Unboxed review covers UFO-testing.
[Tachos] Assuming this one has text fringing right?
[Billybob94111] 200 nitts though? Surely thats a deal breaker.
[Undercut 2241] for some people yes, that's the downside of oled
[Shammy111] Great monitor for this price! I can't decide between a 4k IPS dual mode monitor for 350 or this. Choosing is so hard (profanity).
[WonderBlast] Decent budget OLED monitor. Only issue I've had is that black bars flicker every time while I was gaming, turns out it doesn't work well when you have Wallpaper engine in the background.
